questions.question: Manufacturing on its own earns roughly what share of South Africa's GDP?
"Ship materials out raw and buy the finished goods back" is the losing pattern that which policy answers?
options: Beneficiation — processing minerals and produce locally before export

questions.question: Manufacturing's forward linkages connect it to:
options: The tertiary sector, which moves, sells and finances its goods
The mines it buys ore from
The farms it buys hides from

questions.question: South Africa's showcase manufactured export comes from:
options: The vehicle plants at Rosslyn, East London, Durban and Kariega

subtopics.title: The Types of Industries: A Field Guide

questions.question: The fuel-from-coal complexes at Sasolburg and Secunda are classified as:
Fish canneries stand at St Helena Bay because fresh fish is:
Soft-drink bottlers sit in cities because:
options: Concentrate travels cheaply while crates of full bottles are heavy — the output is the difficult traveller
Their raw materials spoil within hours

questions.question: A software studio choosing its address for skilled people, connectivity and lifestyle is:
Ferrochrome smelters cluster near the Mpumalanga coalfields because:
options: Smelting devours electricity, so plants locate on power
The area has the country's biggest consumer market

questions.question: Paper mills stand on KwaZulu-Natal's rivers because pulp and paper making needs:
Special Economic Zones and Industrial Development Zones belong under which location factor?
options: Political intervention — incentives and infrastructure steering industry to chosen sites

questions.question: In a factory-location scenario, top marks go to the answer that:
options: Recites all eight factors in equal depth
Names the two or three factors that dominate for that industry and justifies them

questions.question: Load-shedding hinders industry because it:
options: Stops production mid-shift, ruins continuous processes and raises investor risk

questions.question: Over-concentration of industry means:
options: One factory making too many products
Industry piled into a few core regions, which choke on congestion while other regions lack investment
Factories located too close to the coast

questions.question: The Vaal Triangle's smoke and south Durban's refinery fumes are this topic's examples of:
An evaluation of South Africa as an industrial location must include, besides the hindrances:
options: Only a map of the regions
The strengths — Africa's most diversified industrial base, deep capital markets, universities and trade access

subtopics.title: Why the Factory Matters: The Ice-Cream Rule

questions.question: In the ice-cream rule, the jump from seven-rand milk to a seventy-rand tub represents:
Selling milk raw across the border and buying back imported ice cream means a country has:
options: Hired another country's factory workers with its own money

questions.question: The hidden gears behind one ice-cream plant are:
options: The freezers on the factory floor
Multiplier jobs — dairy farms, packaging, cold-chain trucking and shops supported by the factory

subtopics.title: The Chip-Shop Test: Where Does a Business Sit?

questions.question: The chip shop stands at the taxi rank rather than the potato farm because:
options: Rent is lower at taxi ranks
Hot chips must be fresh and its customers will not travel — market orientation

questions.question: The one-line version of the chip-shop test says the factory sits at the end that is:
options: Heavier, bulkier or quicker to rot

questions.question: "Every town has its bakery and its brickworks" names which industry type?
The vehicle plants beside East London's harbour, taking components off ships and sending cars back onto them, are:
options: Bridge industries at a break-of-bulk point

subtopics.title: Choosing an Address, and What Makes It Hard

questions.question: "A smelter is essentially electricity made solid" implies a smelter's dominant location factor is:
Failing rail freight hurts industry because:
options: Cargo moves to costlier road transport and the ports back up
Factories must then relocate to farms

questions.question: Over-concentration in one sentence:
options: Every region has too few factories
Nearly all industry squeezes into four regions, choking them while the rest of the country goes without investment

questions.question: The two-handed conclusion weighs the hindrance list against:
options: Africa's most complete industrial machine — diversified factories, banks, universities and open trade doors
